items: Transition metals ki oxidation states badalti (variable) hain, kyun ke yeh alag alag number mein electrons kho kar stable ions bana sakti hain (maslan Fe²⁺ aur Fe³⁺).
Yeh ligands ke lone pairs apne khaali d-orbitals mein le kar aasani se coordination compounds (complexes) banati hain.
Yeh rangeen ions aur complexes banati hain, kyun ke light absorb (jazb) karne par electrons kam energy se zyada energy level par jate hain.
Yeh metals aur in ke compounds catalyst ka kaam karte hain, kyun ke yeh aasani se oxidation state badal lete hain.

blocks.prompt: Iron ki do oxidation states aur un se banne wale ions batayein.

items: Variable oxidation states, complexes, rangeen ions aur catalysis.
